faqs.question: What is PrestaShop development?
faqs.answer: PrestaShop development involves building, customizing, and optimizing online stores using the PrestaShop platform.

faqs.question: Why should I choose PrestaShop for my online store?
faqs.answer: PrestaShop is flexible, cost-effective, and highly customizable, making it suitable for businesses of different sizes.

faqs.question: Can you customize my PrestaShop store design?
faqs.answer: Yes. We customize existing themes or create unique designs that match your brand and business requirements.

faqs.question: Do you provide PrestaShop plugin/module development?
faqs.answer: Yes. We develop custom modules to add new features and functionality to your PrestaShop store.

faqs.question: Can you integrate third-party tools with PrestaShop?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate payment gateways, CRMs, ERP systems, shipping services, and other third-party tools.
